title: No Way Back
description: Every tile you cross seals shut behind you — there's no walking back, no way to ever return to the places you where
body:
# No Way Back!

**No Way Back** turns every step into a commitment.

The moment you leave a tile or block — any (x, z), at any height — it seals behind you with a solid, see-through red wall that runs from bedrock to sky. You can never walk, dig, or climb back onto ground you've already crossed.

### How it works

- Every tile you step off is walled off, full height — the world quietly closes behind you.
- Walls are **unbreakable** in survival and seal the **entire column**, so there's no tunnelling under or climbing over your own trail.
- The sweep is **exact** — even sprinting and diagonal jumps leave no gaps to slip back through.
- **Light on performance**: no per-tile entities, no world scans, just the columns you actually walk.
- Singleplayer or multiplayer — the trail is shared, so it doubles as a co-op "don't cross anyone's path" run.
- Admin tools: `/crimsontrail clear [radius]` to wipe a trail, `/crimsontrail toggle` to switch the challenge on/off.

### Compatibility

- Minecraft **26.2**, **Fabric** (requires Fabric API). Self-contained — no other dependencies.

---

Modpacks are welcome — no need to ask. Please don't re-upload or redistribute the mod outside its official pages.
